name: Viper’s Strike (Combat)
body:
Your movement in battle is fast and precise, like a snakebite.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1 or Dexterity 13, Acrobatics 1 rank

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully make an Acrobatics check to move up to half your speed and avoid attacks of opportunity and you end that movement adjacent to an enemy, you catch them off guard. Your next attack against that enemy before the end of the round treats the target as flat-footed. If the attack is a critical hit, the target is treated as flat-footed against the next attack made against them until the beginning of your next turn.
